insight: The tech industry is shifting from treating AI as an experimental feature to making it the fundamental core of business models, operations, and product strategy. While this transition is driving significant investment and job growth in hardware and specialized software, it is also raising new questions about industrial sovereignty and regulatory compliance. Companies are now focused on building sustainable, value-driven AI businesses that integrate deeply with global infrastructure and security protocols.

articles.title: 17 tech executives reveal how AI agents are changing work and hiring
bullet_points: Tech leaders are using AI agents to transform internal business operations.
The adoption of AI agents is changing how companies approach hiring.
Software companies are adjusting their business models to accommodate new AI tools.

articles.title: SAP’s Sean Kask: software firms must become AI companies or perish
bullet_points: Software firms must integrate AI into the core of their products.
Treating AI as just an extra feature is no longer enough to stay competitive.
Companies risk failure if they do not fully commit to becoming AI-driven businesses.

articles.title: Nvidia-backed Upscale AI launches platform to link chips from rival makers
bullet_points: Upscale AI released a platform called Token Fabric.
The software allows data centers to connect AI chips from different manufacturers.
This tool helps unify hardware systems despite using rival suppliers.

articles.title: Vesta raises $30M for AI agents that work on mortgage decisions
bullet_points: Vesta secured $30 million to advance its AI for mortgage processing.
The technology automates tasks like underwriting for mortgage lenders.
Using this software in Europe would require strict compliance with the AI Act.

articles.title: Anthropic launches free AI security scans for open-source projects
bullet_points: Anthropic introduced a free service called OSS Scanner.
The tool helps open-source projects find security vulnerabilities.
Participating projects receive automated, thorough scans from Anthropic's top models.

articles.title: Building a second-wave AI business
bullet_points: The author shares insights on building AI startups without external funding.
The focus is on how to create real value rather than just jumping on trends.
Success in the next wave of AI requires a clear business model.

articles.title: Huawei and Qualcomm sign patent deal covering 5G, AI and networking
bullet_points: Huawei and Qualcomm signed a multi-year patent licensing agreement.
The deal covers technologies in 5G, AI, computing, and networking.
This partnership highlights the ongoing exchange of innovation between the two firms.

articles.title: Beware the Rise of the ‘Pentagon-Silicon Complex’
bullet_points: Private companies now own key military technologies developed for the government.
This shift creates a new relationship between the Pentagon and Silicon Valley.
There are concerns about what happens if these firms and the government disagree.

articles.title: AI was supposed to kill tech jobs. The data on job openings says otherwise.
bullet_points: Tech job openings are increasing despite fears of AI replacement.
Spending on AI is driving a higher demand for hardware engineers.
Software hiring remains stable and resilient in the current market.

articles.title: Zapata Quantum joins IBM Quantum Network to build quantum applications
bullet_points: Zapata Quantum is now part of the IBM Quantum Network.
The company will use IBM's hardware to develop quantum software for clients.
Zapata focuses on application development rather than building quantum hardware.
